description: This file defines a function to create and manage an authentication controller for embedded runtime agents, handling API key management, token refresh scheduling, failover logic, and error handling.

methods.name: applyPreparedRuntimeRequestOverrides
methods.description: Applies request override configurations to the runtime model based on prepared authentication data.

methods.name: hasRefreshableRuntimeAuth
methods.description: Checks if the current runtime auth state has a non-empty source API key.

methods.name: clearRuntimeAuthRefreshTimer
methods.description: Clears the scheduled runtime authentication refresh timer.

methods.name: stopRuntimeAuthRefreshTimer
methods.description: Stops the runtime auth refresh process and cancels scheduled refreshes.

methods.name: refreshRuntimeAuth
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous refresh of the runtime authentication token, updating state and scheduling next refresh.

methods.name: scheduleRuntimeAuthRefresh
methods.description: Schedules the next runtime authentication refresh based on token expiry and configuration.

methods.name: resolveAuthProfileFailoverReason
methods.description: Determines the reason for failover based on profile cooldown status and error messages.

methods.name: throwAuthProfileFailover
methods.description: Throws an error or failover exception when no valid authentication profile is available.

methods.name: resolveApiKeyForCandidate
methods.description: Resolves the API key for a given profile candidate.

methods.name: applyApiKeyInfo
methods.description: Applies API key information to the runtime model, handling token refresh and state updates.

methods.name: advanceAuthProfile
methods.description: Attempts to switch to the next available authentication profile.

methods.name: initializeAuthProfile
methods.description: Initializes the authentication profile, handling cooldowns and failover.

methods.name: maybeRefreshRuntimeAuthForAuthError
methods.description: Attempts to refresh runtime auth in response to an authentication error.
